title: Standard-WOFOST crop-window transaction and replay contract

required_common_WOFOST_state: actual primary WOFOST biomass and active leaf cohorts
optional_IDSL2_state: legacy_vernalization_rate_carryover only when required for exact B1.10 continuation
conditional_oracle_compatibility_state: legacy_lai_exponential_rate_carryover only in the LAIEXP carryover regime

optional_root_history.SWRDC_1: adaptive per-node root history or semantic equivalent if that physical option is included in a future candidate; not implemented or admitted by F-WOF25

atomic_physical_crop_continuation.atomicity_rule: all enabled physical continuation belonging to the crop execution class must be represented inside one parent F-KT candidate lineage; no independent crop, phenology, biomass or root-history commit authority is allowed

checkpoint_trial_commit.checkpoint_origin: deep clone of the caller-supplied committed physical state under F-KT
checkpoint_trial_commit.finalize_phase_origin: same crop checkpoint plus trial-local prepare context plus frozen accepted aggregates
checkpoint_trial_commit.rollback: discard candidate and trial/window context; never restore by mutating committed state

same_window_read_semantics.soil_water_substeps_read_crop_geometry_f: the parent crop checkpoint/current window start state, plus explicitly prepared same-window read-only process factors where source call order requires them
same_window_read_semantics.reason: legacy root extension/distribution is a day-end crop update after all soil-water substeps

accepted_aggregate_lineage.recompute_after_replay: allowed and must reproduce the same frozen aggregate values for the same checkpoint, forcing and accepted substep history

sequence: run one or more soil/process trials and accepted contributions
run crop finalize to obtain a candidate
run complete one-day crop window with forcing F and accepted process result history A
re-run from the same checkpoint with the same F and A
required: bitwise-identical active cohort ordering and values
deterministic crop results and physical diagnostics
replay_test_contract.warm_start_rule: worker-local numerical warm-start data may differ or be reused, but cannot alter the checkpoint physical origin or accepted result

failure_semantics.invalid_or_incomplete_accepted_aggregate: fail closed before crop finalize or candidate publication

owner_composition_hold.current_F_WOF24_owner: wofost_crop_owner_state_t owns lifecycle DVS plus optional actual biomass but does not yet contain F-WOF25 phenology/climate memory or optional SWRD=2 history
owner_composition_hold.current_F_WOF21_owner: SWRD=2 history exists as a qualified separate crop-lifecycle subtype
owner_composition_hold.required_next_structural_step: compose or extend these source-qualified state semantics into one option-aware WOFOST crop transaction shape without duplicating DVS/LAI/WRT/root depth
